weakness: Owner's always-on router at Customer B: password-only portal, default local password, no per-session approval, never approved in writing
source: P07 assessment (AC-17 objectives); P03 G-018, G-027; P01 R-003
remediation_plan: Keep the router powered off except for sessions Customer B approves by phone (since 2026-09-03); MFA on the portal; Customer B plant management decides between its own gateway and removal
milestones: 2026-09-30 portal MFA on; 2026-10-31 written decision from Customer B; 2026-12-31 router replaced or removed
resources_required: Owner time; no cost if removed

weakness: No MFA on the accounting SaaS administrator account or the router portal
remediation_plan: Turn on MFA with the authenticator app on both; store recovery codes in the sealed envelope (POL-01 9.6)

weakness: No backup independent of sync; restore one file at a time; no integrity record
source: P07 assessment (CP-09 objectives); P03 G-023, G-034; P01 R-001
remediation_plan: Weekly encrypted backup to two rotating external drives kept offline (one off site); laptop image after the rebuild baseline; quarterly test restore checked against library hashes
milestones: 2026-10-31 drives in use and first full test restore; 2027-01-31 second quarterly test

weakness: USB sticks unencrypted, shared across customers, and not scanned; Customer A station skipped on night calls
remediation_plan: Never skip Customer A's station (POL-01 7.2, from 2026-09-11); one encrypted stick per customer, scanned on the laptop before each use; wipe old sticks
milestones: 2026-09-11 rule adopted; 2026-10-31 encrypted sticks in use and old sticks wiped

weakness: No hash check before firmware loads; no hash record for library programs
source: P07 assessment (SI-07 objectives); P03 G-014, G-040; P01 R-004
remediation_plan: Hash check before every load recorded on the job ticket (POL-01 7.4); tell Customer A about the 4 unverified loads; library index with hashes
milestones: 2026-09-30 Customer A told and check in use; 2026-12-31 library index complete
resources_required: Owner time (about 12 hours for the index)

weakness: Shared home network; bridged legacy virtual machine; Wi-Fi on while cabled to machines
source: P07 assessment (SC-07 objectives); P03 G-024, G-027; P01 R-009, R-012
remediation_plan: Separate business Wi-Fi with household devices on the guest network; host-only virtual machine; Wi-Fi off when cabled (POL-01 Appendix C)
milestones: 2026-10-31 settings changed and checked by the IT consultant
resources_required: Owner and IT consultant time (2 hours)

weakness: Customer machine passwords in a spreadsheet; no password procedure; default router password found
source: P07 assessment (IA-05 objectives); P03 G-016; P01 R-005
remediation_plan: Password manager with a vault per customer; delete the spreadsheet and its versions; ask customers to change shared passwords when work ends

weakness: No incident criteria, contact list, or notice procedure
source: P07 assessment (IR-06 objectives); P03 G-033, G-039, G-045; P01 R-013
remediation_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and notification matrix (2026-09-11); print contacts for the van and home; walk through with the IT consultant

weakness: No supplier requirements or oversight; AI-001 holds Customer A data without consent
source: P07 assessment (SA-09 objectives); P03 G-005, G-006, G-036; P01 R-007
remediation_plan: Supplier list and terms (POL-01 Appendix A); Customer A consent under a no-training addendum, or vendor deletion (P10); annual supplier review
milestones: 2026-09-30 Customer A decision requested and uploads stopped; 2026-10-31 supplier list complete

weakness: Legacy virtual machine has no malicious code protection
source: P07 assessment (SI-03a.[01]); P03 G-025; P01 R-009
remediation_plan: Host-only networking and no internet for the virtual machine (POAM-006); scan every file moved into it on the host; retire it with the older controllers
